_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.
name: Isagi

anim._doc: T-083. Spec: research/fable-tickets.md section 1.4 (the 1.x tables are the spec; ENEMIES.md behavior sentences are frozen per D-040). One entry per table row, keyed by a snake_case state id; 'row' repeats the exact table row label. spec_frames are the section 1.4 frame names in table order; frames are the files that exist on disk, relative to this folder (T-016 produced TBD placeholders - see frame_map and DECISIONS D-T083-1/D-T083-2: isagi_idle_00 -> fire_00, isagi_shoot_00 -> fire_02, isagi_ball_00 -> shot_00; fire_01 exists on disk but is unreferenced). Timings are in 60 Hz ticks and are binding; the attack frame lands on the tick its kill resolves. Effects are shader/transform effects on the billboard and never change body_rect.
